title: Theme additions (chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, snackBarTheme) in app_theme.dart
objective: Add chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, and snackBarTheme to both light() and dark() ThemeData builders in lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart so that downstream refactors (Batches 2-8) can rely on inherited defaults instead of hardcoded colors, radii, and animation durations.
description: Currently the only component themes configured are appBarTheme, cardTheme, filledButtonTheme, outlinedButtonTheme, textButtonTheme, inputDecorationTheme, iconTheme, and dividerTheme. The new chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, and snackBarTheme are required so AppChip/Chip variants (Batch 4) and snackbar rendering inherit consistent shape (RoundedRectangleBorder with Radii.chip / Radii.button), padding (Spacing tokens), and selection color (AppColors.primary). progressIndicatorTheme is used by AppLoadingIndicator (Batch 7). All values must be sourced from lib/ui/core/tokens/ — no hardcoded color or numeric values.

anchors: lines 28-104 — light() ThemeData builder (insert new themes after filledButtonTheme/outlinedButtonTheme/textButtonTheme block at ~line 76)
lines 107-183 — dark() ThemeData builder (mirror new themes after textButtonTheme at ~line 155)

design_changes.dark_equivalents: Mirror the above using darkColorScheme and darkTextTheme; use AppColors.primaryLight as dark-mode selectedColor to preserve the existing brand palette.

acceptance_criteria: lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart declares chipTheme, progressIndicatorTheme, and snackBarTheme inside the light() builder's ThemeData(...) call (after the textButtonTheme block at lines 72-76)
The same three themes are declared in the dark() builder (after the textButtonTheme block at lines 151-155)

No hardcoded Color, Duration, EdgeInsets, BorderRadius, or numeric values are introduced — every value references an AppColors / Radii / Spacing / AppTypography / AppDurations token from lib/ui/core/tokens/
chipTheme uses Radii.chip (the existing chip radius token) for shape
chipTheme.selectedColor is AppColors.primary (light mode) and AppColors.primaryLight (dark mode)
snackBarTheme.backgroundColor uses inverseSurface from the respective ColorScheme (no hardcoded hex)
snackBarTheme.actionTextColor uses inversePrimary from the respective ColorScheme
Existing component themes (appBarTheme, cardTheme, filledButtonTheme, outlinedButtonTheme, textButtonTheme, inputDecorationTheme, iconTheme, dividerTheme) remain unchanged
flutter analyze lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart returns no errors
The file still compiles with useMaterial3: true and both light/dark builders export unchanged signatures

validation.manual_review: Open app_theme.dart and confirm chipTheme/progressIndicatorTheme/snackBarTheme appear twice (once per brightness) with token-sourced values only

no_op_outside_scope: Do not modify any tokens file. Do not modify app_color_schemes.dart or app_text_themes.dart. Only edit lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart.
blocks: Batches 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 depend on these themes being available so chip/button/progress colors inherit from ThemeData instead of being inline-overridden.
